description: DeepSeek-Coder-V2 is a Mixture-of-Experts code model with 236B total parameters (21B active). It supports 338 programming languages, 128K context window, and achieves performance comparable to GPT-4 Turbo on code-specific tasks.

trainingData.description: Built on DeepSeek-V2 with 6 trillion tokens of additional training. Extended from 16K to 128K context.

trainingProcedure: Continued pre-training from DeepSeek-V2 with code and math focus.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Comparable to GPT-4 Turbo on code tasks. Outperforms Claude 3 Opus and Gemini 1.5 Pro on code benchmarks.

knownLimitations: Full model requires 8x 80GB GPUs for inference
May generate code with bugs or security vulnerabilities
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: May reflect biases in code training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Instruct variants have safety tuning applied.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for sensitive code.
